test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty tank completely in 42 minutes and 56 minutes respectively. Pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 84 minutes. All the three pipes are opened together for 8 minutes and then C is closed. In how much time (in minutes) will A and B together fill the remaining part of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe A = 42 min

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe B = 56 min

Time taken to empty a full tank by Pipe C = 84 min

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

LCM of 42, 56, and 84 is 168

⇒ Efficiency of A = 168/42 = 4 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of B = 168/56 = 3 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of C = 168/84 = 2 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of B and A together = 4 + 3 = 7 units/min

⇒ A, B and C opened for 8 min = (7 - 2) × 8 = 40 units

Now, Pipes A and B will fill the remaining empty tank = 168 - 40 = 128

⇒ Time = 128/7 = ​​18(2)/(7) mins

**∴ Time taken by Pipes A and B to fill the remaining tank will be 128 / 7 mins or 18(2)/(7) mins.**

1e
